0022600227.text: The 76ers (9-3, 2nd in the East) host the Toronto Raptors (5-5, 6th in the East) in Philadelphia's 13th game of the 2026-27 season, with the 76ers coming off a one-game losing streak and sitting 7-3 over their last ten. Philadelphia is without Adem Bona (back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back fracture), while Toronto is missing Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), Nate Bittle (foot fracture), Scottie Barnes (groin soreness) and Trayce Jackson-Davis (illness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, and the 76ers won the most recent meeting 115-102 in Toronto on January 12, 2026.
